Hard cases all in train: N1 (defer to find-software-developer for general dev — bidirectional pair test against find-software-developer's N2), N2 (LLM-product comparison with strong vendor-name overlap), N5 (consumer ed-tech — the failure mode that originally deferred this skill in plan.md), and indirect-intent positive P7. passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.
